title: RiverHaven
description:
Short Term Rental Permit #: 2017081769  Accommodates 2 to 4 guests. Two bedrooms, sitting area and bath offer privacy in an upstairs area. Guests will also have access to the kitchen. This home built in 1926 offers charm and warmth in a park setting only 20 minutes from downtown Nashville. Located in a quiet neighborhood, your stay will be relaxing and peaceful as you enjoy the view of the Cumberland River.

The space
Guests will have the entire upstairs which includes TWO BEDROOMS, a sitting area and one bath with shower and claw foot tub. The use of original kitchen and breakfast nook are available for light breakfast. Refrigerator and microwave also included.

Guest access
Guests will be able to sit outside and view the river. Perhaps the General Jackson or a river barge will come by.

During your stay
I will be happy to help with area restaurants and activities. If peace and quiet are what you're looking for, there is plenty of that here.

Other things to note
RiverHaven is 10 minutes from East Nashville where there are many restaurants, a park and a golf course. Nature and art are only minutes away. Downtown Nashville is 20 minutes away where the Country Music Hall of Fame is a main attraction. Opryland is across the river only 10 minutes away.

The peace of the river has been a haven to me and my family. We call our home built in 1926, RiverHaven. My life saying is seek peace and pursue it.
